{"metadata":{"description":"DSH plugin: stop qwen3.8-27b from burning its output budget on thinking during context compaction","id":"gh:1345719578","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-qwen38-compaction-fix","slug":"zhubaohi/dsh-qwen38-compaction-fix","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH plugin: stop qwen3.8-27b from burning its output budget on thinking during context compaction"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Qwen3.8 (NInfer) Compaction Fix"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Fix for a local **qwen3.8-27b** gateway running on the **NInfer** engine that fails to compact. The "},{"id":"p3s2","text":"model thinks at `xhigh`, spends the entire output token budget on reasoning before reaching a conclu"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"sion, and the compaction checkpoint comes back truncated. This DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) plugin disab"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"les thinking **for compaction calls only** and applies, to those calls, the sampling parameters the "},{"id":"p3s5","text":"model recommends when thinking is off."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> **Scope: NInfer only.** This package is written for gateways served by the
> NInfer engine (`ninfe"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"r-serve`, OpenAI-compatible API): the wire
> fields it rewrites (`reasoning_effort`, `presence_penal"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ty`, `repetition_penalty`, `min_p`) are the
> ones the NInfer gateway interprets. If your qwen3.8 is"},{"id":"p4s4","text":" launched by something else
> (llama.cpp, vLLM, FastMTP, ...), the same idea — turn thinking off for"},{"id":"p4s5","text":" dsh's compaction and
> session-title calls so `xhigh` reasoning cannot burn the entire output budge"},{"id":"p4s6","text":"t — still applies,
> but each engine speaks different wire parameters, so this package does not clai"},{"id":"p4s7","text":"m to fix those
> launch methods."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Then restart `dsh web` (or refresh the GUI page). The plugin is also listed in the DSH
plugin market"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" (Settings → Plugin Market → search "qwen38")."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## The symptom"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"When context pressure builds, dsh compacts the conversation into a checkpoint. With a local **qwen3."},{"id":"p9s2","text":"8-27b** running at its default reasoning level, compaction sometimes fails, and the session is left "},{"id":"p9s3","text":"with exactly this line:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"> summarization truncated at the token cap (incomplete checkpoint)"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"That is dsh-compaction-basic's verdict that the summarizer hit its output token cap without finishin"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"g. The conversation is condensed only into the truncated text: everything the summary never reached "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"is effectively lost from context."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Why it happens"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Local **qwen3.8-27b** deployments think at their default effort: `xhigh` in a typical route config, "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"on every call that does not explicitly set a reasoning effort. Compaction is one such call. The mode"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"l is asked to write a long summary of the whole conversation. At `xhigh`, it spends the **entire `ma"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"x_tokens` output budget on reasoning tokens before ever writing a word of the summary**. The respons"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"e hits the cap with no conclusion, and you get the truncated checkpoint above."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## The fix"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"1. **Disable thinking for compaction only.** Stamps `reasoning_effort: "off"` onto the compaction ca"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ll (waterfall layer, resolved through the model's `reasoningEfforts` declaration to the wire value `"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"reasoning_effort: "none"`): zero reasoning tokens, and the whole output budget is available for the "},{"id":"p15s4","text":"summary. Every other call, whether a normal turn, a subagent, or a request for any other model, keep"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"s the route's `xhigh`. Thinking is never disabled globally.
2. **Apply the sampling parameters recom"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"mended when thinking is off.** **qwen3.8-27b** publishes different recommended sampling parameters f"},{"id":"p15s7","text":"or thinking mode and for the mode with thinking disabled. The plugin writes the second set (`tempera"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"ture: 0.7, top_p: 0.8, top_k: 20, min_p: 0.0, presence_penalty: 1.5, repetition_penalty: 1.0`) into "},{"id":"p15s9","text":"the compaction request body, so the request actually matches the mode it is in.
3. **Restore the out"},{"id":"p15s10","text":"put budget.** Raises the wire `max_tokens` of compaction bodies up to a configurable floor (default "},{"id":"p15s11","text":"`16384`; the value is never lowered), undoing the context clamp in pi-ai that can collapse `max_toke"},{"id":"p15s12","text":"ns` on large conversations.
4. **Fix session titles (secondary).** Session title generation runs on "},{"id":"p15s13","text":"the same route with a tiny output budget (`maxTokens: 64`), so `xhigh` thinking truncates titles too"},{"id":"p15s14","text":". The plugin writes the configured `reasoning_effort` wire value into title request bodies. The titl"},{"id":"p15s15","text":"e provider locks its LLM options in place before the waterfall, so only the wire body is reachable."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Everything else is untouched. Every gate checks the purpose and the model (waterfall), or the signat"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ure and the model (HTTP), so conversation turns, subagents, and any other model pass through unchang"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"ed, byte for byte, with the route defaults. Every guard fails open."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## The model name must match: read this first"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The plugin only acts when the `model` field of the outgoing request matches an id in the `models` al"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"lowlist: default exactly `qwen3.8-27b`, case sensitive. It is an **exact id match, not a family or s"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"ubstring match**, because the sampling parameters written into the body are specific to this model a"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"nd would be wrong for any other model."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Four cooperating layers:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"1. **`llm/stream` waterfall:** for calls whose `purpose` is in `purposes` and whose `options.model` "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"is in `models`, resolves the model's offered reasoning efforts and stamps the chosen effort in place"},{"id":"p22s3","text":" before dispatch.
2. **HTTP sampling:** wraps the process `fetch`; when a chat completion body carri"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"es the compaction engine's final instruction (a stable signature) and its `model` field is allowed, "},{"id":"p22s5","text":"applies the configured sampling entries — wire fields as spelled for the NInfer gateway.
3. **HTTP m"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"ax_tokens floor:** same gate; raises the output cap to the floor; never lowers it.
4. **HTTP session"},{"id":"p22s7","text":" title reasoning:** when a body carries the title provider's system prompt (stable signature) and it"},{"id":"p22s8","text":"s `model` is allowed, writes the configured `reasoning_effort` wire value."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Identity at the HTTP layer relies on the instruction text shipped by dsh-compaction-basic and dsh-se"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"ssion-title-llm. If a future dsh release changes those instructions, the matching HTTP gate silently"},{"id":"p23s3","text":" stops matching and the body keeps its wire defaults. The other gates are unaffected, and nothing ev"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"er breaks LLM traffic, because every guard fails open."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Limitations"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- **Engine scope: NInfer.** The wire fields this plugin rewrites are the ones the NInfer gateway int"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"erprets. Gateways served by other engines (llama.cpp, vLLM, FastMTP, ...) may ignore or spell these "},{"id":"p25s3","text":"fields differently; the same thinking-off idea can be ported to them, but that port is a different p"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"ackage.
- Model matching is an **exact id match** against the id declared under `llm-pi-ai.providers"},{"id":"p25s5","text":".<provider>.models[].id` in `settings.yaml`. See the model name section above.
- The HTTP layer sign"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"atures track specific dsh releases; see "How it works" for what happens when a signature stops match"},{"id":"p25s7","text":"ing.
- This plugin shapes requests for the *local gateway* you run. It does not change the harness's"},{"id":"p25s8","text":" own routing or the server's real capacity limits (the server still enforces them)."}],"truncated":true}
